stages.title: Foundations
stages.summary: The opening chapters and the easy, low-risk side content you can knock out while you're still learning the map.

stages.title: Strands & Side Hustles
stages.summary: Mid-story chapters plus every stranger strand you need to close out before its cutoff, run alongside early collectible routes.

stages.title: Grind & Specialist Challenges
stages.summary: Shooting Range golds, stunt chains, card sets, drone races and the rest of the skill- and volume-based grind.

stages.title: Completion & Platinum
stages.summary: The 100% completion push, the big cumulative counters, and the platinum popping once everything above is done.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself — it pops automatically the instant your 54th trophy does, with no separate condition of its own. There's nothing to chase here beyond finishing everything else on this list; work the roadmap stages in order and it falls out on its own at the very end.
steps: Clear every other trophy on this checklist — story, missables, and every counted grind trophy.
Leave the biggest cumulative counters (money spent, choices made, laundering) running in the background so they're already near their target.
Watch for the pop the moment your 54th trophy lands; no extra input is needed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The completion percentage rolls up every story mission, stranger strand, activity type, collectible set and side objective the game tracks. Save this for dead last — clearing every other trophy on this checklist should put the percentage at or very near 100% on its own, leaving only odds and ends to mop up.
steps: Clear every other trophy on this list first — story, missables, collectibles and grind counters.
Open the pause-menu completion tracker and check which category is short.
Mop up whatever's left (usually a handful of minor collectibles or activities) until the percentage reads 100%.

Chain jumps, near-misses and drift moments every lap rather than driving cleanly.
Check the activity log periodically — the 250-stunt counter climbs passively, so pair it with other driving-heavy trophies.
